content.comment_body: With [product_name] base units, specifically the FS:04 and FS:05 versions, a problem may arise after continuous operation exceeding 50 days: the display (including onboard display, [product_name] display device, and web server) stops refreshing, and programmed function keys and cursor keys become unresponsive. Units that experience more frequent voltage interruptions (less than 50 days), such as those with a mains switch, do not show this issue. The problem has been resolved in firmware version [version_no], which can be installed at no cost on affected devices. See [url] for details.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have reported a major issue with certain [product_name] base units (FS:04 and FS:05) where extended operation beyond 50 days causes the onboard display, external display devices, and web server to stop updating, along with malfunctioning user input keys. Regular resets of the power supply prevent the issue. A free firmware update has been released to address the problem.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] base units to perform reliably during long-term continuous use, ensuring that displays and input keys work consistently.
